pose: A straight, rigid tail handle ending in a massive, bulbous bone club.
visual_hook: The 'Wrecking Ball'. The vertebrae in the last half of the tail are fused into a stiff rod to swing the heavy club.
material: Matte, heavy grey bone. The club has a rough, pitted, armored texture.
inset_view: Top-right corner: Cross-section of the club showing it is a solid mass of reinforced bone.
